Name: Triple Shot Espresso Retexture To-Go
Author: thetevinterelf
Description:
[b][size=4]What does this mod do?[/size][/b]
In the vein of silvermoonchan's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29331]Coffee To Go[/url] (using their pixel art as base as per their permissions) I added a retexture for the triple shot espresso.

[b][size=4]How do I install the mod?
[/size][/b][list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI, if you haven't already.
[*]Install Content Patcher, if you haven't already.
[*]Download the (one) main file.
[*]Unpack either directly into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder or to somewhere else.
[*]Pick a version of the cup you like most inside the [font=Courier New]/assets[/font] folder (see the images above!)
- v 1: with the added lightning on the paper band
- v 2: with darker-tinted coffee
- v 3: with a red lid
- v 1_2: lightning + darker tint
- v 1_3: lightning + red lid
- v 2_3: darker tint + red lid
- v 4: all of the above, lightning + darker tint + red lid
[*]Rename that file from (for example) [font=Courier New]triple v1.png[/font] to [font=Courier New]triple.png[/font][font=Arial].[/font]
[*]Make [i]sure[/i] you don't have a typo, otherwise the change won't happen.
[*]If you hadn't moved the folder into your [font=Courier New]/Mods[/font] folder yet, do that now.
[*]Start the game like you usually would!
[*]Have fun and find peace knowing the farmer is not, in fact, running around with hot coffee in an open mug anymore! (:
[/list] 
[b]How do I install the GMCM Version?[/b]
- very easily! 
- simply download the version made by the very kind Hayato2236 in the [i]files[/i] tab and move the unpacked folder into your [i]Mods[/i] folder
- configure your version in the GMCM [the same names as above equal the same outputs!]
- start the game like usually
- have fun! (:[list=1]

[/list]
[b][size=4]How do I uninstall the mod?
[/size][/b][list]
[*]Simply remove the folder, the mug should go back to normal, even if you had one in your inventory.
[/list]
[b][size=4]Further Notes
[/size][/b]This is my very, very first mod. I've play-tested it and asked my friends to play-test it as well, and it worked perfectly well. However, if there is anything that happens that you think is part of this mod (nothing I can currently imagine, because of my lack of experience, honestly), leave a comment or a bug report. Otherwise, [i]please[/i] please check out the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29331]original mod[/url] by silvermoonchan.
